text:
Sarah Lee: Quick help — FinTrack POC wants a trial org and billing project mapped to their tenant. They need: dedicated pool access for low-latency inference, a hard spend cap at $2k, short-lived keys for engineers, and project-level quotas. Who needs to do what?

Jamal Ortiz: @Sarah — recommended flow:
1) Create a billing org "FinTrack-POC" and a child project "fintrack-poc-1".
2) Seed project with $2,000 trial credits and enable spend cap (no autopay beyond cap).
3) Create a service account scoped to only generate+embeddings; mint short-lived API keys (72h) for devs.
4) Set token/day quota to 5,000,000 and per-key rate limit to 10 rps.
Let me know the customer email and desired region and I'll provision.

Maria Gomez: Adding a couple of product notes:
- For Hosted API this is straightforward. You can attach the project to a Dedicated pool later.
- For Dedicated: infra needs the pool name and VPC CIDR to whitelist before we attach. That typically adds 24-48h.
- For Private: we'll need their peering and KMS details up front.

Ryan Chen: infra checklist (for Dedicated):
- target_region: us-west-2
- pool_size: 2xA10G
- VPC CIDRs to whitelist (they must provide)
- expected qps and p95 latency target
I'll open an infra ticket once you confirm region + CIDRs.

Sarah Lee: Customer email is ops@fintrack.ai, region us-west-2, they want the dedicated pool but can start on Hosted. Send the infra ticket please.

Jamal Ortiz: I'll provision the billing project now. Sample provisioning API call (internal):

```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.com/v1/internal/projects \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "org":"FinTrack-POC",
    "project":"fintrack-poc-1",
    "seed_credits_usd":2000,
    "spend_cap":true,
    "quotas":{
      "tokens_per_day":5000000
    }
  }'
```

Jamal Ortiz: And for key creation (short-lived):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"project":"fintrack-poc-1","scopes":["generate","embeddings"],"ttl":"72h","rate_limit_rps":10}'
```

billing-bot: Billing project fintrack-poc-1 created by Jamal Ortiz. Seed credits: $2000. Spend cap: enabled. Admins: sarah. Notification sent to ops@fintrack.ai

Maria Gomez: One more thing — make sure the SSO/SAML mapping lines up with the customer's identity provider so their engineers can rotate keys. For SOC2 customers we also attach the compliance package (audit logs retention + KMS integration).

Sarah Lee: Perfect. @Ryan — I'm going to cc ops@fintrack.ai on the infra ticket and ask for CIDRs. I'll also send the POC runbook with quotas and key rotation policy. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Ryan Chen: Got it — will create infra ticket and loop you in. Expect 24-48h for pool provisioning once CIDRs are provided.

Sarah Lee: Closing for now — will reopen if customer requests extension beyond $2k.
